digest.component_or_area: outbound mutation builders and field-diff seams
propositions: _compute_outbound_update_mutation accepts 24 loose positional and keyword-only parameters spanning disparate concerns (remote observation, transport, binding state, mapping policy, diagnostics, mutation output)
compute_update_fields and diff_canonical_fields similarly accept 14 and 11 loose values respectively, forcing synchronized edits across builder, caller, and helper boundaries when new axes are added
Typed payload union and portable parity oracle from predecessor stories have not yet rewired any producer to use cohesive typed request objects instead of loose parameter bundles

Producer seams must be refactored into per-pass-invariant context (binding_store, client, pass_id, mappers, links, snapshots, resolvers) plus separate mutable-sinks bundle (absent_alive_fields, conflict_sink, dropped_field_sink) to reduce mutation builder argument count from 24 to ~7

Refactoring must preserve production routing, retry/idempotency/fuse, and transport-resource ownership semantics unchanged, and avoid generic Mapping[str, Any] option bags in favor of cohesive typed dataclasses
